_comment: TB-direct read-plane test fixture (design §5). Mirrors the shape TB returns from GET /api/tenant/devices?textSearch=... — a PageData { data:[device], hasNext, totalElements }. The plain Device entity has NO `active`/`lastActivityTime` (OOHDASH-80: the earlier /api/tenant/deviceInfos swap, PR #33, was WRONG — that endpoint does not exist on this TB and 400s, breaking all inventory). Online status is sourced per-device from SERVER_SCOPE (GET /api/plugins/telemetry/DEVICE/{uuid}/values/attributes/SERVER_SCOPE?keys=active,lastActivityTime → [{key,value}]). OOHDASH-85: `online` is now FRESHNESS-authoritative — the adapter emits lastActivityTime = now - `lastActivityAgeMs` so tests are time-independent; `active` is corroboration only (never flips a fresh device). Fresh (age < 48h) → online; stale (age > 48h) → offline; `active` below still feeds the SERVER_SCOPE route to prove it can NOT override freshness. Plus per-device latest-telemetry { key:[{ts,value}] } from .../values/timeseries. Keyed by tbName. The 6261 set includes a bleed neighbour (gk-62611) so the anchored client-side filter is exercised; names carry realistic C4 exception classes.
